newsitem.title: UK: BT firm, among SBC Warburg picks for 1997.
newsitem.headline: BT firm, among SBC Warburg picks for 1997.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc were actively traded in a dull UK equity market on Thursday as the stock was included in SBC Warburg's list of ten preferred stocks for 1997, traders said.
BT was up 1/2p at 395 by 1154 GMT in volume of 3.98 million shares, making it the most active stock in the FTSE 100 index. Analysts at SBC Warburg were not immediately available for comment.
J.Sainsury Plc, also included in the list, was another of the market's few firm features as shares succumbed to the New Year's Eve tumble on Wall Street.
Sainsbury was up 1/2p at 388-1/2, even as the FTSE 100 index traded 30.5 points lower at 4,088.0 in thin volume of 161 million shares.
